proposals.title: Guest Comment Pass
proposals.oneLiner: Allow users to post a single comment as a guest after viewing a rewarded ad, providing a taste of social engagement without sign-up.

newMechanic.name: Guest Comment Pass
newMechanic.description: A temporary bypass that allows non-logged-in users to post one comment on an article without signing up for an AOL account, after viewing a rewarded ad.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Currently, commenting is gated behind a 'Sign Up to Post' wall, preventing unregistered users from engaging. This pass offers a low-friction entry to social features, potentially increasing engagement and driving future account creation.

proposals.trigger: User finishes typing a comment on the Add Comment Page (s05) and sees the 'Sign Up to Post' button, indicating a wall. The new 'Post as Guest' button is offered as an alternative.
proposals.eligibility: Non-logged-in users in their 2nd+ session, not in sensitive content contexts. Capped per user per day.

offer.title: Post Your Comment Now
offer.body: Play a quick game with AOL to post this comment instantly, no sign-up required. Your post will appear as 'Guest User'.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: This feature provides access to an action currently unavailable to non-logged-in users, serving as a trial for the social aspect of the app. It does not replace any paid features as no subscription for commenting exists, nor does it grant full account benefits. It may encourage future sign-ups by showcasing community value.

kpis.primary: Total comments posted by guest users (via rewarded ad) and subsequent account sign-up rate.
guardrails: D7 / D30 retention for new users
kpis.holdout: User-level randomized holdout (5-10% of non-logged-in users for 28 days)

risks: Potential for spam or low-quality guest comments if moderation is insufficient, impacting community quality.
Low opt-in rate if users don't perceive enough value in a single guest comment.
Brand safety concerns with user-generated content in proximity to ads. Requires robust content moderation for guest posts.

evidence.quote: User attempts to post a comment on an article and hits the sign-up wall.

newScreens.change: A modal overlay for the rewarded offer invitation, appearing above the Add Comment Page.

newElements.change: A new button labeled 'Post as Guest' placed slightly above the existing 'Sign Up to Post' button.

callouts.text: User drafts a comment, ready to post.
The 'Sign Up to Post' button is the only path.

The 'Sign Up to Post' option remains.

storyboard.caption: A 'Post as Guest' button is added as an alternative, offering a new path to engagement.

callouts.text: The rewarded ad offer appears after tapping 'Post as Guest'.

storyboard.caption: The user taps 'Post as Guest' and is shown an invitation to play a game for a free comment.

callouts.text: User plays a short mini-game with AOL, the Game Partner.

storyboard.caption: The user opts in and completes a short rewarded mini-game.

callouts.text: The user's comment is successfully posted.

storyboard.caption: Upon completion and verification, the user's comment is posted, and they are returned to the conversation screen.

scenario.label: Scenario, not a forecast: 5% of DAU engage, 1.5 views each, US mid eCPM after a 25% non-game haircut.

proposals.title: News Streak Multiplier
proposals.oneLiner: Drive daily reading habit through a gamified streak mechanic that can be doubled by watching rewarded ads.

newMechanic.name: Daily Reading Streak
newMechanic.description: Users earn 1 point for every day they read or save at least one article. Points accrue for achievements and profile badges.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a meaningful, scarce engagement resource to anchor the rewarded ad value exchange.

proposals.trigger: After the user taps 'Save this article' (e38) on the News Feed Home screen (s13), confirming a daily reading action.
proposals.eligibility: All non-paying users who have completed their daily reading goal (saved at least 1 article).

offer.title: Double Your Streak Points
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to double your Daily Streak points for today.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is a retention-focused meta-game point (engagement), not a substitute for a paid subscription tier or ad-free access. This creates positive sampling effects for the app without devaluing existing content.

kpis.holdout: 10% of total users held out from the Streak Multiplier offer for 30 days.

risks: Points may be perceived as trivial if they do not unlock tangible benefits like badges or profile themes.
Potential for user fatigue if the multiplier is offered every day without sufficient engagement.

proposals.title: Bonus Save Slot
proposals.oneLiner: Watch a quick game to expand your article library.

newMechanic.name: Library Capacity Limit
newMechanic.description: Limit free account article saving to 50 slots.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a scarce resource anchor for rewarded ads.

offer.title: Expand Your Library
offer.body: Play a quick game to add 5 more save slots.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is additive, not subtractive. Saved article limit is a non-core engagement feature and does not impact ad-supported reading experience [TAX-7].

kpis.holdout: 10% user holdout for 4 weeks to measure total engagement.

risks: Users may be frustrated by the introduction of a new limit on a previously unlimited feature.

newElements.change: Add storage status (45/50 slots) and 'Expand Library' CTA button.

Introduce a 50-article save limit to the account menu.
When user nears the limit, the expansion offer appears.
User plays the interactive rewarded mini-game.
Library capacity is updated immediately upon verification.

scenario.label: Scenario, not a forecast: 15% of DAU engage, 1.2 views each, US mid eCPM after a 25% non-game haircut.

proposals.title: Bonus Save Slot
proposals.oneLiner: Watch a quick game to expand your article library.

newMechanic.name: Library Capacity Limit
newMechanic.description: Limit free account article saving to 50 slots. Existing saved articles remain fully accessible; new saves are blocked until expansion or subscription.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a scarce resource anchor for rewarded ads, distinguishing free from premium tiers.

proposals.trigger: User opens the sidebar menu, where capacity is displayed.

offer.title: Expand Your Library
offer.body: Library full (50/50). Play a game for +5 slots, or see premium plans.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is a partial, additive expansion for non-payers. Subscription plans remain clearly superior (unlimited storage).

kpis.holdout: 10% user holdout for 4 weeks to measure capacity usage and revenue impact.

risks: Frustration risk from capping previously unlimited storage; mitigated by clearly stating existing content is safe.
Low utilization if users do not save many articles; mitigated by capacity usage monitoring.
